gate: Control is the felt drive at the core of this code, but not the bullying kind. This is the practical pull to put a hand on the wheel of a situation that nobody is steering. Resources, money, the small calendar of who does what on Thursday, the matter of how a household or a project actually keeps itself alive. A person carrying this drive feels uneasy in rooms where no one is in charge. The reach for the wheel happens almost before thought. Most readings of this go wrong at exactly that reach, calling it ego or a need to dominate. The reach is older than ego. It is the body answering a real lack in the field, a missing hand on the rudder. The misread arrives later, when the hand keeps grabbing for the wheel even after someone else has taken it, even when the wheel is already held steady.
centre_field: This drive is wired into the part of you that backs a promise with the fuel to keep it, the engine of will and capacity that sits in the chest behind the ribs. Only some bodies are built to run that engine continuously, which is why the wider world quietly idealises a kind of stamina most people are not made for. Placement is the teaching. The urge to manage is hooked into the motor of doing, not into the head where it could stay theoretical, which is why it can actually be enacted, and why it burns out when it is asked to run without rest. The engine works in pulses, not in a flat line. Value lives alongside it. The same part of you that reaches for the wheel is the part that knows the cost of what is being steered, and knows what the steering is worth.
channel: On its own, this code has nowhere to put itself. The urge to lead is real, but leading without a gathered group is only restlessness with no object, a hand closing on empty air. What this drive needs is the other code that calls people in and holds them there as a community, the one that turns scattered individuals into a circle worth steering. The lineage calls the joined pair the channel of money, the tribal current that takes the will to take charge and the assembled tribe and makes them one working piece. Without the other half, the controlling pull has no field to operate in, no resources actually pooled, no one looking up to be steered. It stays a hand on an empty wheel. The gathering gives the steering somewhere to go. This code is built to need a tribe before its leadership becomes anything more than the private pressure of a body that wants to take charge.
